title: Pilot deployment of a machine-learning enhanced prediction of need for hemorrhage resuscitation after trauma - the ShockMatrix pilot study.
summary: XGBoost on nine prehospital predictors produced a model for need for hemorrhage resuscitation, developed on a Traumabase cohort of 28,614 patients with an 11% event rate and reaching an F4 score of 0.76 (0.73–0.78), followed by a real-time multicenter feasibility pilot. The prospective app phase measured feasibility and compared clinician and model likelihood ratios, but the article states it was underpowered and not intended to assess model performance.
